import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read()
    # unescape json strings: each '\n' in real text became \\\n; replace \\n with newline? careful: only in actual grid rows. Do it globally.
    g=t.replace('\\n','\n')
    G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',g):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in g[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows) and k not in G:
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
